title: Daniel Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Daniel 3: the golden image on the plain of Dura, the three men who would not worship it, and the burning fiery furnace.

questions.text: How high was the image of gold that Nebuchadnezzar made?
questions.explanation: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold whose height was sixty cubits and its width six cubits.

answers.text: Sixty cubits
Six cubits
Sixteen cubits
Ninety cubits

questions.text: Where did the king set up the golden image?
questions.explanation: He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

answers.text: In the citadel of Susa
Beside a river outside the city
In the plain of Dura
In the royal palace of Babylon

questions.text: What did the herald say would happen to whoever did not fall down and worship?
questions.explanation: The herald announced that whoever did not fall down and worship would be cast into the middle of a burning fiery furnace the same hour.

answers.text: He would be cast into the den of lions
He would be cast into a burning fiery furnace
He would lose all his possessions
He would be driven out of the province

questions.text: Which men did the Chaldeans accuse before the king?
questions.explanation: The Chaldeans said that certain Jews appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, did not serve the king's gods or worship the golden image.

answers.text: The judges, the treasurers and the sheriffs
Daniel, Belteshazzar and Arioch
Ashpenaz, Arioch and Belteshazzar
Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego

questions.text: What did the three men answer the king about their God?
questions.explanation: They said their God whom they serve is able to deliver them from the burning fiery furnace, but that if not, they still would not serve his gods or worship the golden image.

answers.text: That they would worship the golden image just this once
That their God had commanded them to obey the king
That God is able to deliver them, and that they will not worship the image
That they would worship both their God and the image

questions.text: How much hotter did the king command the furnace to be heated?
questions.explanation: Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury and commanded that the furnace be heated seven times more than it was usually heated.

answers.text: Seven times more than usual
Three times more than usual
Ten times more than usual
Twice as hot as usual

questions.text: What happened to the men who took up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego?
questions.explanation: Because the king's commandment was urgent and the furnace exceedingly hot, the flame of the fire killed the men who took them up.

answers.text: They were promoted by the king
They fled from the furnace unharmed
They were bound and cast in as well
The flame of the fire killed them

questions.text: What did the king see when he looked into the fire?
questions.explanation: The king said he saw four men loose, walking in the middle of the fire, unharmed, and that the appearance of the fourth was like a son of the gods.

answers.text: Three men bound and lying still
Four men walking loose in the fire, unharmed
An empty furnace with no one in it
Three men and a pillar of cloud

questions.text: What did the officials notice about the three men after they came out?
questions.explanation: They saw that the fire had no power on their bodies, the hair of their head was not singed, their pants were not changed, and the smell of fire was not even on them.

answers.text: The fire had not harmed them and no smell of fire was on them
Their hair was singed but their skin was whole
Their clothes were burned away by the flame
They could no longer speak or stand upright

questions.text: What did the king do for the three men at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the province of Babylon.

answers.text: He sent them home to Judah
He put them in prison for a time
He promoted them in the province of Babylon
He made them serve the Chaldeans
